reasoning: Clearly depicts a standard half-charged vertical battery, universally understood for tasks about household batteries, rechargeable packs, power banks, and charging. While UI icon sets often include many nearly identical fill levels (20%, 50%, 80%), this generic half-full glyph works well as the canonical battery icon in a task list.

pass1.ambiguity: Almost identical to other partial battery level icons (30%, 50%, 60%); at small sizes can slightly resemble a small bottle with a cap or a USB drive.
